text:
Type: two-door sideboard with gallery top
Use: storing dishes, linens and serving pieces; dining room, living room, hallway
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: black-painted wood, vertical beadboard-paneled doors, small dark knobs
Colors: black, dark charcoal
Shape: upright cabinet with two tall doors of vertical grooved boards, raised gallery rim around the top, overhanging top, small knobs at the center, heavy plinth base, solid and tall, heavy visual weight
Feel: rustic, sturdy, cozy, classic
Goes with: white walls, warm wood, cream textiles, brass or pewter accents; farmhouse, country or traditional dining rooms
